integrity: Complete algebraic finite-integer optimization proven by exact positive-coefficient identities, corroborated by a separate rational finite census. Original source supplies marginal closure and pairwise analysis; the novel claimed contribution is the global third-cumulant optimizer classification. No independent audit or outside validation has occurred.
limitations: Fixed-size uniform Poissonian batch resetting and independent 1D Brownian diffusion only. Only the unnormalized joint third cumulant of three distinct squared positions is optimized; no claims for nonuniform batches, higher cumulants, or non-Poissonian events.
title: Two sharp batch-size transitions for a connected three-particle resetting correlation
